title: Corpus automine runner
description: Mine a catalogued corpus, reflect with RelOps, collect possible-cause evidence (not proof), splice cues into the next ask, pivot, re-cause, expand catalogued follow-ons. Domain-neutral: the detected spec/domain-*.json supplies the catalog, KPI, scan entities, pivot columns, families, and evidence label. Identification is none. The SLM never writes SQL.

domains.detect: Each spec/domain-*.json has an automine.detect column list. The domain whose columns all exist on the booted schema wins; gene and finance ship.
domains.note: Per-domain reflect settings live in the domain spec (automine block), not here.

gate.supported: live cue pairs name at least one catalogued candidate
gate.review_required: live pairs exist but no catalogued candidate appears in them
gate.refused: no bound text column or no live pairs — nothing is invented
gate.note: Gate on bound RelOp evidence. Supported means pairs named a catalogued candidate — not proof.

reuse.when: a saved .revolverelate/automine.json has the same reuseKey and stop=goalReached

memory.note: Evidence rows are chunked into the dummy OverlayChunk so the next pass can knn-recall them with the same RelOp as live text. Chroma syncs from the same table when opted in. Never a live table.

honesty: Possible-cause evidence from bound RelOp pairs and catalogued candidates. Identification is none. Not conclusive proof, not a discovery claim, not investment advice.
